details:
The project is about a site that gives you information about abandoned tools and equipments on moon and mars

What it does?

The project is about a website that provides information about abandoned tools and equipment on the Moon and Mars. Users can see the missions, the tools used, the locations of the missions, the purpose of the tools, why they were created, the problems faced during their development, and how they changed history. 

How it works?

When you search on the internet, you can find our website and see the Moon and Mars on your screen Then You can choose a location and click on it to view the mission and tools in that area. You can also go to our library to search for specific tools or missions. 

What benefits does it have?

First of all, the site is free of bugs and lagging issues. We collected information for weeks and used our years of knowledge in space to make the summaries and details of missions and tools as easy to understand as possible. This can help the people of Tajikistan a lot, because about 30% of Tajiks know Russian and 2% know English, and there is a lack of information—especially about space—in the Tajik language. We will help them learn about these topics. 

What is the intended impact of the project?

First, as I mentioned, there is a lack of space-related information in Tajik, so we are helping educate people in Tajikistan. Furthermore, the site is available not only in Tajik but also in Russian and English, so it will help people all around the world—especially students—since it is one of the easiest and most efficient websites to learn about space. 

What tools, coding languages, hardware, or software did you use to develop your project?

We used Next.js, Three.js, WebGL, and TypeScript for programming. 

How is it creative?

Our website is creative on its own, but the most creative part lies in its information. While most people use AI for website content, we used our own minds and explanations. This makes it special because it is easy to study, learn, and highly efficient. 

What factors did you consider?

First, we considered the language barrier, because knowledge and information should not be limited by language. Every person, city, country, and land has the right to learning resources, which is why we plan to add more languages to our site in the future. 

Second, our goal is to educate people worldwide, not to make money it’s for educating people the platform is free and easy to understand. 

Third is accuracy as I said our goal is edu people how we can educate people when we have wrong information we did a lot of research we talked with professors and more for accuracy of the information and how Much effective it is

Fourth smooth user experience we made sure that site is perfect without bugs and lagging so u can learn and use the website without any problems
